name: Kimi Code CLI
notes: Sub-agents are Markdown with YAML frontmatter in .kimi-code/agents/ (also read from .agents/agents/); fields per Moonshot's docs: name, description, whenToUse, tools, disallowedTools. Tool names follow the Claude-Code vocabulary. User-level equivalents live under $KIMI_CODE_HOME (default ~/.kimi-code/). (`whenToUse` is left out: the description already says when to invoke, and repeating it verbatim only spends context.)
